title: What Happens If You Ride the Clutch
hook: Stop resting your foot right there.

script.narration: Stop resting your foot right there.
script.visual_search: driver foot resting on clutch pedal inside car

script.narration: Hovering your foot on the clutch pedal applies tiny pressure to the release bearing. Over time, this constant friction burns out your clutch disc early.
script.visual_search: manual car gear shifter and pedals close up

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you drive manual? Comment yes or no.
script.visual_search: hands on steering wheel driving on open road

script.narration: Always keep your foot clear so you never stop resting your foot right there.
script.visual_search: driver foot firmly on dead pedal floor

description:
Learn what happens to your manual transmission when you ride the clutch pedal. A quick driving tip for stick shift drivers to avoid costly repairs.

Master your manual car with these quick driving tips for beginners.
